justification: In `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/resolution/logic/MethodResolutionLogic.java`, the class is 1324 LOC and declares 31 methods, with many public entry points (`isApplicable`, `isAssignableMatchTypeParameters`, `replaceTypeParam`, two `findMostApplicable` overloads, `findMostApplicableUsage`, `solveMethodInType`, `inferTypes`, and parameter-type helpers). The implementation केंदizes several distinct responsibilities in one class: applicability checks for declarations and MethodUsage, varargs grouping, lambda/functional-interface conflict checks, generic/wildcard/type-parameter substitution, overload specificity selection, and type inference. That breadth and method count show the class could be split into smaller, more cohesive abstractions.
